title: Iowa Code Chapter 70A (Financial and Other Provisions for Public Officers and Employees)
source_id: Iowa Code ch. 70A, sections 70A.1 to 70A.41 (Title II); leave at 70A.1
verified_how: Fetched that URL (HTTP 200, 32167 bytes): banner 'Iowa Code - 2026', 'Title II - ELECTIONS AND OFFICIAL DUTIES', 'Chapter 70A - FINANCIAL AND OTHER PROVISIONS FOR PUBLIC OFFICERS AND EMPLOYEES', 40 section entries from 70A.1 'Salaries - payment - vacations - sick leave - educational leave.' to 70A.41 'Public employee health insurance.'
notes: Scope caution: this is the leave entitlement for state officers and employees only. Iowa has no private-sector paid leave, sick leave or holiday-pay statute; private vacation and holiday pay is enforceable only as 'wages' under ch. 91A. The one general private-sector leave provisions are narrow: 91A.5A 'Holiday time off - Veterans Day.' and 91A.5B 'Treatment of adoptive parent employees.', both seen in the ch. 91A listing. Family and medical leave is federal (FMLA).
